headline: VC Giant A16z Broadens Investment Focus Beyond Crypto into AI and Tech
summary: Venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) is widening its bets beyond cryptocurrency to embrace artificial intelligence and other emerging technology themes.
why: Andreessen Horowitz is a prominent Silicon Valley venture capital firm whose capital allocation shifts signal broader institutional trends in technology funding.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: Capital inflows from major venture investors into artificial intelligence support startup valuations and ecosystem growth.
